lines: Care is not revealed in the final outcome alone. It is revealed in the preparation, grounded in the details.
In decades devoted to study, in published scientific research, in thousands of cases examined in depth, and in the discernment that only time and experience can bring.
When I step into surgery, everything around me ceases to matter.
Because, in that moment, knowledge, experience and decision-making must act in perfect harmony.

Neurosurgery demands technical precision, but it also demands something beyond technique: the maturity to weigh complex scenarios, make difficult choices and assume the responsibility that each decision carries.
Perhaps that is the profession's greatest mission.
To draw on everything we have learned over a lifetime to offer the patient what they need most in that instant: safety, care and the chance of regaining their health and moving forward.
In the end, each procedure represents far more than a medical act.
It represents the chance to restore quality of life, preserve stories, reclaim interrupted plans and allow someone to return to their family, their routine and their plans for the future.
And so, at the end of every surgery, my gratitude is always shared — with the patient and their family, for the trust placed in our work.
With the team that walks beside me every day, for the competence, commitment and dedication at every stage of this process.
Neurosurgery is built on knowledge, but results are only possible when there is trust.

seo.title: Clinical areas — vascular and cranial microneurosurgery
seo.description: Cerebral aneurysm, AVMs, moyamoya, brain, pituitary and spinal tumors, schwannoma, cavernomas, trigeminal neuralgia and hemifacial spasm.

hero.title: My Specialties
hero.intro: Cerebrovascular conditions, neurovascular conflicts and complex cranial tumors — from diagnosis to the treatment decision.

steps.title: Assessment
steps.text: A detailed consultation, review of your exams and attentive listening to your clinical history.

steps.title: Diagnosis
steps.text: Precise investigation with advanced imaging technology and multidisciplinary discussion.

steps.title: Treatment
steps.text: An individualized plan — microsurgery, endovascular or radiosurgery, according to each case.

steps.title: Follow-up
steps.text: Rehabilitation and close follow-up throughout the whole recovery.

cta.heading: Didn't find your condition? Talk to me.
cta.text: Every case is unique. Schedule an evaluation so we can discuss the treatment path suited to your condition.

vascular.title: Vascular microneurosurgery
vascular.intro: Diseases of the brain's blood vessels — when the artery wall, the connection between vessels or the blood flow is compromised.

conflitos.title: Neurovascular conflicts
conflitos.intro: When a vessel compresses a cranial nerve and produces pain or involuntary movement in the face.

tumores.title: Complex cranial tumors
tumores.intro: Lesions growing inside the skull or at its base, close to nerve structures that must be preserved.
